admin_intel_page_subtitle: Configure analyzers, debug runs, and inspect costs.
admin_intel_disabled_body: All recommendation generation is paused. Users can't see the Intelligence page, and manual refreshes are blocked.
admin_intel_blocked_by_provider: Settings, analyzers, and run history are hidden until an AI provider is configured. Once a provider is set up, this page will populate.
admin_intel_no_provider_body: Intelligence needs an AI provider before it can generate recommendations. Configure one (Anthropic, OpenAI, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint) on the AI settings page.
admin_intel_actions_description: Start a manual run for any user. The last run time and active recommendation count help you spot who's overdue.
admin_intel_analyzer_primary_list_descri: Suggests setting a primary list when the user has multiple active lists but none are marked primary.
admin_intel_analyzer_primary_list_exampl: You have 3 active wishlists but none are marked primary. Set one so people who want to shop for you know where to look first.
admin_intel_analyzer_list_hygiene_descri: Suggests list changes ahead of upcoming birthdays, Christmas, and custom holidays, such as converting a list, making it public, creating one, or setting a primary list, depending on the user's current lists.
admin_intel_analyzer_list_hygiene_exampl: Your birthday is in 14 days and your only public list is a Christmas list. Convert it to a birthday list and rename it so gifts auto-reveal on the right day.
admin_intel_analyzer_relation_labels_des: Reminds users to tag their mother or father when Mother's Day or Father's Day is coming up.
admin_intel_analyzer_relation_labels_exa: Mother's Day is in 7 days. Tag a parent so the system can remind you and shape your gift-tracking.
admin_intel_analyzer_stale_items_descrip: Reviews items not edited in 6+ months and asks the model to flag any worth cleaning up.
admin_intel_analyzer_stale_items_example: "Wireless headphones (model XYZ)" hasn't been touched in 11 months and the linked product is discontinued. Consider archiving or replacing it.
admin_intel_analyzer_duplicates_descript: Finds items with similar titles across different lists and asks the model to confirm true duplicates.
admin_intel_analyzer_duplicates_example: "Stanley tumbler 30oz" appears on both your Birthday list and your Wishlist. Looks like the same item, so keep one and remove the other.
admin_intel_analyzer_grouping_descriptio: Suggests "pick one" or "in order" groups for ungrouped items that look like alternates of the same need or a prerequisite sequence.
admin_intel_analyzer_grouping_example: These three coffee grinders look like alternates of the same need. Group as "pick one" so gifters know to only buy one.
admin_intel_analyzer_missing_price_descr: Surfaces items that have a URL but no price recorded so the user can fill one in.
admin_intel_analyzer_missing_price_examp: "Stanley tumbler 30oz" has a link but no price set. Adding one helps gifters budget.
admin_intel_analyzer_missing_image_descr: Surfaces items where the scraper found candidate images but none have been picked yet.
admin_intel_analyzer_missing_image_examp: The scraper found 4 candidate images for "Levis 511" but no image is set on the item. Pick one.
admin_intel_analyzer_stale_scrape_descri: Surfaces items whose linked product hasn't been re-scraped in months (or was never scraped).
admin_intel_analyzer_stale_scrape_exampl: The link on "Wireless headphones" was last scraped 9 months ago. Refresh to catch price/availability changes.
admin_intel_analyzer_clothing_prefs_desc: Asks the model to flag clothing items missing a size or color and suggest common options.
admin_intel_analyzer_clothing_prefs_exam: "Levis 511 jeans" has no size noted. Common adult sizes are 30x32, 32x32, and 34x32. Add yours.
admin_intel_settings_description: All settings are global. Per-user overrides aren't supported yet.
admin_intel_general_description: General behavior, inputs, and retention. All settings are global.
admin_intel_schedule_help: Recommendations are regenerated for each user on a schedule, and whenever someone clicks "Run for me now". The schedule runs at most once per refresh interval for each user, and manual runs wait out the cooldown so they don't pile up.
admin_intel_refresh_interval_hint: How often the cron will regenerate recommendations for each user.
admin_intel_cooldown_hint: Minimum gap between manual runs for the same user.
admin_intel_analyzers_help: For each user, the analyzers run one after another, and an error in one doesn't stop the rest. Partial failures show up in each run's status in the table below.
admin_intel_analyzers_card_summary: {enabled} of {total} enabled. For each user, the analyzers run one after another, and an error in one doesn't stop the rest.
admin_intel_audience_help: The cron currently processes every user who isn't banned. You can't yet turn it on for only some users, so to limit the rollout, disable individual analyzers above or turn the whole feature off.
admin_intel_inputs_help: The candidate cap limits how many items each analyzer sends to the model. A smaller cap makes runs cheaper and faster, but some recommendations may be missed. Dry run still calls the model and records each step, but doesn't save any recommendations.
admin_intel_candidate_cap_hint: The most items (or item pairs) sent to the model in a single run.
admin_intel_workers_help: Advanced. These control how many users each cron run processes, and how many it handles at once. Only raise them if your AI provider's quota can handle it. Rate-limit errors show up as step errors on individual runs.
admin_intel_concurrency_hint: Number of users processed in parallel inside one invocation.
admin_intel_users_per_invocation_hint: The most users a single cron run will process before it stops.
admin_intel_retention_help: Dismissed and applied recommendations, and the debug records for each run, are deleted once they're older than these limits.
admin_intel_stale_rec_retention_hint: Dismissed and applied recommendations older than this are deleted.
admin_intel_run_step_retention_hint: Debug records for each run step (prompt, response, and parsed output) older than this are deleted.
admin_intel_recipient_override_placehold: Leave blank to send to all admins
admin_intel_recipient_override_help: When set, every digest (scheduled or sent now) goes only to this address instead of the admins.
admin_intel_hygiene_help: The list hygiene analyzer suggests list changes ahead of upcoming birthdays, Christmas, and the holidays you've set up, such as converting a list, making it public, creating one, or setting a primary list. These settings control when those suggestions start and stop for each event.
admin_intel_upcoming_window_hint: Suggestions start once an event is this many days away. For example, 45 starts about six weeks ahead.
admin_intel_min_days_hint: Suggestions to convert, create, or change privacy stop once the event is this close. With 1, they stop on the day of the event.
admin_intel_rename_ai_help: When this is on, the Convert action asks the AI provider (the same one the other analyzers use) to suggest the new list name. The model only sees the current name, the new list type, the event title, and the year. It never sees items or claims. If the AI is unavailable or its answer can't be used, the name comes from the built-in rules instead. Limited to 5 calls per run.
admin_intel_stale_help: Old public lists can also be flagged for archiving (which can be undone) or for conversion to a plain wishlist. This check never looks at claims or at what a recipient has archived, so it can't spoil a surprise. Higher values leave lists alone for longer, which is the safer choice for avoiding spoilers.
admin_intel_stale_past_event_label: Days Past Event Before Flagged Stale
admin_intel_stale_past_event_hint: Christmas, birthday, and holiday lists are only flagged once their event is at least this many days in the past. For example, 90 waits about three months after Christmas before suggesting an archive.
admin_intel_stale_inactive_label: Months of Inactivity Before Flagged Stale
admin_intel_stale_inactive_hint: A list is flagged only when neither the list nor any of its items has been edited in this long. Applies to every eligible list type, including wishlists. 12 months matches the yearly auto-archive cycle.
admin_intel_scheduling_description: How often recommendations regenerate, and how the cron processes batches of users.
admin_intel_notifications_description: Email the deployment’s admins a periodic digest of system-wide intelligence activity.
admin_intel_email_not_configured_body: Sending the digest needs a Resend API key and a From address. Set up email first, and these controls will unlock.
admin_intel_no_recipients: No admin users, so nothing will send. Set a recipient override.

match.countPlural=one: The digest goes out with the intelligence cron, once every refresh interval ({count} day). Send now delivers the current digest right away, even when the toggles are off, and doesn't change the schedule.
match.countPlural=*: The digest goes out with the intelligence cron, once every refresh interval ({count} days). Send now delivers the current digest right away, even when the toggles are off, and doesn't change the schedule.

admin_intel_runs_description: Most recent recommendation runs across every user. Click a row to inspect run details.
admin_intel_debug_no_steps: No steps recorded for this run. The run may have been skipped before any analyzer executed (see skip reason above).
admin_intel_debug_no_recs: No recommendations were persisted for this run. Check the steps above to see what each analyzer returned. Analyzers can run successfully and still produce no recommendations (for example, when nothing is stale and there are no duplicates).
admin_intel_debug_heuristic_note: Heuristic-only step, no model call. Latency above is the analyzer's own logic.
admin_intel_detail_heuristic_only: Heuristic only. No candidates were sent to the model.
admin_temp_holidays_description: Per-user feed of the next closest holidays for the signed-in user. Sources: admin-curated Custom Holidays, the hard-coded gift-giving holidays (Christmas always, Valentine's when partnered, Mother's / Father's Day when the user has a matching relation label), and the user's anniversary when partnered with an anniversary date set. The iOS widget renders the closest 3 within the configured horizon.
admin_temp_holidays_horizon_help: Hide holidays further out than this. The iOS widget config exposes the same horizon as a 30 / 60 / 90 / 180 / 365 picker.
admin_temp_holidays_data_description: Every row the server would return for the signed-in user (capped at 50 by the debug query). Rows outside the {horizon}-day preview horizon are still shown so you can see why.
admin_temp_holidays_empty: No holidays surfaced for this user. Add some in the Custom Holidays admin section, tag a parent in the Relationships settings, or partner up to unlock Valentine's and the anniversary row.
admin_temp_holidays_none: No holidays in the next {count} days.
admin_temp_birthdays_description: Universe = anyone whose lists you can see (same set as the home page). For each one with a birthday on file, show countdown plus a warning when you haven't gifted them recently. Sliders below let you tune the thresholds.
admin_temp_birthdays_horizon_help: Hide people whose birthday is further out than this. The web home page surfaces ~30 days as a soft callout.
admin_temp_stale_threshold_help: Show the warning indicator when lastGiftedAt is older than this (or null).

match.countPlural=one: What the widget would render right now from {count} person with birthdays on file.
match.countPlural=*: What the widget would render right now from {count} people with birthdays on file.

admin_temp_birthdays_data_description: Per-user computed values for everyone returned by {#code}/api/lists/public{/code}. Rows hidden by the horizon are still shown so you can see why.
admin_temp_birthdays_none: No birthdays in the horizon window.
admin_digest_subject_quiet: Intelligence digest: no runs this period
admin_digest_footer: Health, coverage, cost, and dismissals cover this period. Outstanding recommendations and applied totals are as of right now. This email goes to the site's admins. You can change it under Admin → Intelligence → Notifications.
